answer: Quadratic staking lock-up forces each Sybil node to pledge collateral proportional to the square of its weight, so aggregate attack capital grows as O(n^2) while honest stake scales linearly. a zero-knowledge verifiable delay embeds an anchor delay that makes front-running infeasible, and slashing penalties of 1.5x the staked amount guarantee negative expected utility for any coalition; the resulting marginal cost curve intersects violet ocean of extractable value at a point where rational validators converge to a unique Nash equilibrium.
